# Account Executive

Train a leading AI lab's model on presentations and slide decks

Share
[Apply](https://agent.askethos.com/opportunities/account-executive/apply)

Role

Account Executive

Interview

AI voice screen included

## About this opportunity

We're working with a leading foundational AI lab to find experienced account executives from top B2B and SaaS companies who can help train their latest language model on professional presentation and slide deck tasks. We're looking for AEs with 2+ years of experience to create, evaluate, and refine AI-generated presentations and slide decks across core workflows: storyline development, executive summary writing, slide structuring, horizontal and vertical logic, data-driven exhibit design, and client-ready deck production.

**Compensation:** $100/hour
**Commitment:** Flexible, 5-20 hours per week (or more if desired)
**Location:** Fully remote, work on your own schedule
**Start date:** ASAP

**Qualifications:**

- 2+ years as an Account Executive at a top high-growth B2B or SaaS company
- Deep expertise in structured communication, storylining, and slide craftsmanship
- Expert-level PowerPoint and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail

## Key requirements

- 2+ years as an Account Executive at a top high-growth B2B or SaaS company
- Deep expertise in structured communication, storylining, and slide craftsmanship
- Expert-level PowerPoint and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail

Interested in this opportunity?

Submit your application and our team will review it. You may be invited to a short AI voice screen as a next step.

[Apply Now](https://agent.askethos.com/opportunities/account-executive/apply)
